protocol.name: full limecoli 384 assay 4-plate multi-duration
protocol.description: 4-plate limecoli 384 assay with multi-duration illumination (60s, 120s, 180s) across 4 wavelengths (630nm, 592nm, 525nm, 460nm). Plates 1-2 run at 25C, plates 3-4 at 37C.

parameters.name: equilibration_seconds
parameters.label: Equilibration Time (seconds)
parameters.description: Time to equilibrate each plate (default 600s / 10 min)

parameters.name: warmup_count
parameters.label: Warmup Reads
parameters.description: Number of warmup reads before illumination cycles

parameters.name: recovery_count
parameters.label: Recovery Reads
parameters.description: Number of recovery reads after each illumination

parameters.name: repetitions
parameters.label: Illumination Sweep Repetitions
parameters.description: Number of times to repeat the full duration x color illumination sweep per plate
